summary: Re-enables outgoing email via Postfix relay through PostShiba with SMTP auth; removes email-problem banners; root-deploy has sasl_password/sasl_passwd typo that breaks deploy.

statements.text: Nothing flagged (plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets...)
statements.why: Secrets area has a real problem: root-deploy installs sasl_password but postmaps sasl_passwd under set -e, so deploy aborts and email stays broken; also needs an SMTP credentials file on the server.

misses.what: Deploy script typo (sasl_password vs sasl_passwd): root deploy fails and outgoing mail stays broken.
All outgoing email now relays through third-party PostShiba using SMTP credentials that must be on the server before deploy.
Email-problem warning banners removed from password-reset and invite pages.
Postfix option renamed postscreen_blacklist_action -> postscreen_denylist_action (needs newer Postfix).
